witness: cr4ckm3_0x (ELF x86-64, statically linked, stripped; challenge 5e51836e33c5d4439bb2dc24) 0x400f30 -> sub_417f80 @0x401007, reduced and vendored as decompiler/crates/kuna-analysis/tests/fixtures/calleearityscratch_x86_64
decisions: THE FILED HYPOTHESIS WAS ALREADY OVERTURNED IN THE NEED and the refuter's diagnosis held under my own instrumentation. It said `single-site callee analysis does not establish its arity`; kuna has exactly that (`calleearitybody`, default-on) and it establishes the run {rdi} correctly here. The loss is one line further on, in `calleearitycut`'s boundary test.

REPRODUCED AND INSTRUMENTED. Printing every BodyTrial at the captured call shows all six SysV register trials scoring inactive and the run picked as {rdi}; the boundary trial is rsi, whose Varnode at the CALL slot is written (a loop MULTIEQUAL over the unrolled XOR body) and so fails `caller_quiet`. `accepts_cut_run` returns false and the whole one-argument list is dropped.

THE DISCRIMINATOR IS UPSTREAM'S OWN, ALREADY COMPUTED. Argument setup is a value used for nothing but the call -- `Funcdata::onlyOpUse` -- and `FuncCallSpecs::checkInputTrialUse` runs `ancestor_op_use` over every trial and marks it ACTIVE only when that is true. rsi's trial is INACTIVE here because the caller reads sil in the XOR. So the widening reads `trial.is_checked() && !trial.is_active()` rather than inventing a second walk; no new analysis, no new decode.

THE WITNESS'S SIL USE IS NOT VISIBLE ON THE 8-BYTE rsi VARNODE. Instrumented: that Varnode's only descendant is the CALL, because the byte read hangs off the 4-byte esi in the def chain. A naive `has a descendant other than the CALL` test would have MISSED the witness; `ancestor_op_use`, which walks the def chain, does not. This is why the recorded trial verdict is the right thing to read and a locally-computed one is not.

A CONSTANT IS NEVER SCRATCH, and this restriction is load-bearing, not decoration. The `boundary_const` control (`mov $2,%esi; add %rsi,%rbx` before the CALL) scores checked+INACTIVE, so the trial verdict alone would accept it; instrumented, `caller_constant` is what refuses it. Materializing a constant into the next argument register right before a CALL is argument setup in its most literal form.

THE FAILURE MODE IS BOUNDED BY THE RULE IT WIDENS. `calleearitycut`'s contiguity and stops-short conditions are untouched, and `capture_lone_call` only ever fires on a site that recovered NOTHING, so the worst reachable outcome is a SHORT argument list against a site that was printing an empty one -- never an argument in the wrong position, and never an argument removed.

IT IS ITS OWN OPTION rather than a relaxation of `calleearitycut` because it is a judgement call with a real cost (a boundary the caller both computes and consumes could still be a further argument), and because `calleearitycut` shipped default-on with the narrower contract that its own module header argues for.

THE NEED'S OTHER TWO INSTANCES ARE A DIFFERENT DEFECT and the T_DEDUP note said so before I started: the witness is a TOTAL loss (zero arguments) and goes through `calleearitybody`/`calleearitycut`, which are eligible only for a call that recovered nothing at all; 6a095817 (memcpy keeps 2 of 3) and 6a148dd6 (init_state keeps 1 of 4) are PARTIAL and are `calleearitylive`'s territory. Closing this need does not close them and their return in a later round is not a regression.

sweep.no_op_check: a per-binary call-arity histogram over both arms (name -> arity -> count): NO zero-argument form increases anywhere, and the only positive-arity count that falls is `CONCAT71/2` in CrackMe.exe (20 -> 16), which is the printer's concat pseudo-op being hoisted into a variable and reused, not a call. So no call anywhere lost an argument.
sweep.checked_against_source_or_the_line_besid: `__subvdi3(v5,src)` in OpenBSD `strlcpy` x4 (ssh, ssh-agent, ssh-keyscan, ssh-pkcs11-helper) -- the function returns `s - src - 1` and `__addvdi3(v4,0xffffffffffffffff)` is the next line; `sub_1ad20(v17,v10,a0,a1)` in `almost` matching the `sub_1a2f0(v17,v10,a0,a1)` in the sibling branch of the same `if`; `sub_14001d34c((long long)(int)fd)` in CrackMe.exe / `sub_1406b5274` in crackme_shroud.exe feeding `FlushFileBuffers`, which is MSVC's `_commit`; `sub_1400180f0(*(long long *)&v2[0x76])` in phantomgate.exe under its own `if (ptr)` guard; `sub_140001800(v)` x11 in vm.exe, one per opcode handler.
sweep.downstream_churn: 6 of the 38 changed functions gain no argument themselves -- they are the callers whose OWN dataflow shifts because a call inside them gained one (a hoisted subexpression, a renumbered local, a re-rolled loop). Read individually, all 6 are the same shape: a repeated expression becomes a named variable. None loses a statement.

speed.verdict: no measurable cost. The single-target number is inside this machine's known noise floor (docs/features/returncopysplit/record.json measured -20.23% on byte-identical output), which is why the 31-second whole-binary pair is the one to read: -0.03%. Structurally the rule reads three booleans already recorded on a trial, on a call `calleearitybody` had already captured, and takes no new decode.
